0022600116.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder host the LA Clippers with both teams at 1-0: the Thunder are 2nd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, while the Clippers lead the Pacific and sit 2nd in the West. The Thunder won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 128-110 win in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Out for the Thunder are Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery).
